name: – Michael Gahler – After recital L – Am 50
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: Lb. whereas since May 2026 Volodymyr Zelenskyy has been a Distinguished Member of the European Order of Merit; whereas the European Order of Merit was established to honour individuals who have made significant contributions to European unity, democracy or to the promotion and defence of European reconciliation; whereas former leader of Solidarność and former President of Poland Lech Wałęsa, who is also a Distinguished Member of the European Order of Merit, declared that Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s decision to name one of Ukraine’s special operations forces unit Heroes of the Ukrainian Insurgent Army (UPA) is a personal insult to him and all murdered Poles; whereas, in light of these concerns, the Selection Committee of the European Order of Merit should revoke Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s membership of the Order;
